report_discrepancies.note: Road Fund budgetary schedule omits the 223,456 sale of assets, so its ending fund balance 925,112 differs from the statement's Road Fund ending balance 1,148,568 (p5).

notes: Cash basis. Statement 'Taxes' 4,639,172 (p6) split using the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): Property 3,917,674 + Motor vehicle 323,828 + Lodging 397,670 = 4,639,172 exactly (inheritance tax is its own statement line). Fund-level tax lines stay taxes (unlabeled) except the Visitor Improvement and Visitor Promotion funds (lodging, from fund name; together 397,670 = Statement of Activities lodging). Sale of assets 223,456 in other_financing. 'Local' lines are a mix of charges for services, interest and miscellaneous; recorded as charges for services (largest part) with review. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances Total column (pp3-4), which equals the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p10); Inheritance Tax Fund and Health Insurance Fund columns from the General Fund combining statement (p7; Veteran's Aid Fund column all zeros); Road, Disaster Recovery and Visitor Improvement budget schedules (pp11-13); nonmajor funds (15 columns) from the Total Non-Major Funds column (p9). Disaster Recovery disbursements 794,183 are its debt service (statement p6: principal 490,000, interest 304,183). The beginning balance reclassification of the Health Insurance Fund into the General Fund (933,345) nets to zero in the total column. Read pages 1-13 of 13.
